commandRunner.$comment: Left out of the per-mutant command: the two files that start real child processes, installSeam.test.ts (a fresh Node child per case, since camoufox-js reads its install directory once, at import), which ci.yml runs on every push, and install.smoke.test.ts (skipped unless CAMOUFOX_INSTALL_SMOKE=1), which the camoufox-install job runs; a bailed worker killed while it starts a child can leave the child stuck in the kernel (PR #11)
commandRunner.command: pnpm exec vitest run --coverage.enabled=false --bail=1 --exclude test/installSeam.test.ts --exclude test/install.smoke.test.ts
